description: This Lua source file defines a security download plugin for the lighttpd web server. It provides a 'secdownload' function that configures and loads a handler for secure file downloads with secret-based authentication, handling options like prefix, document root, secret, and timeout. It also registers this function as an action that can be invoked within the server configuration.

methods.name: secdownload
methods.description: Configures security download handler with provided options and loads the corresponding Lua handler script.
